result.description:
General Practitioner (Part Time) — Willagee WA 6156 

  Role:  General Practitioner / GP |  Type:  Part Time |  Start:  Immediately 

About the Practice

 This busy mixed-billing medical practice in Willagee seeks an experienced and patient-centered General Practitioner to join a supportive team. Our clinic operates under a mixed billing model and serves diverse families, seniors, and individuals across the local area. The environment blends professionalism with a friendly, motivating culture that values innovation, growth, and clinical excellence. 

What We Offer

 
	  Remuneration:  Competitive percentage on billings at  70% , reflecting our commitment to rewarding clinical productivity. 
	  Billing Type:  Mixed billing, bulk billing pension cards, health care cards and children 15 and under, ensuring accessible care for patients. 
	  Flexible Hours:  Part time roster with options to tailor hours to work–life balance needs. 
	  Parking Provided:  Onsite or nearby parking made available for clinicians. 
	  Supportive Culture:  A blend of friendly, fun, and professional values that encourages learning, mentorship, and innovation. 
 

Key Responsibilities

 
	 Provide high-quality general practice consultations across a broad range of presentations  
	 Manage chronic disease, preventative care, acute presentations, and routine health assessments. 
	 Collaborate with nursing staff, allied health, and administrative teams to ensure coordinated patient care. 
	 Maintain accurate clinical records, comply with practice policies, and participate in quality improvement activities. 
	 Contribute to a positive workplace culture by mentoring, sharing best practices, and participating in team meetings. 
 

Who We Are Looking For

 
	 Qualified General Practitioner with appropriate Australian registration and experience in primary care. 
	 Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and as part of a team within a busy community practice. 
	 Excellent communication skills, patient empathy, and a commitment to evidence-based clinical care. 
	 Interest in ongoing professional development and contributing to practice growth and innovation. 
 

Why Join Us

 You will join an established practice that values clinical autonomy and teamwork, where your skills directly impact patient outcomes and community wellbeing. Enjoy flexible scheduling, reliable parking, and a culture focused on continuous improvement, fun, and professional satisfaction. This role suits a GP seeking part time clinical work with meaningful patient engagement and the opportunity to shape service delivery in a supportive, growth-oriented environment. 

 We welcome expressions of interest from experienced General Practitioners who meet the residency requirements and are ready to start immediately.   Apply Now
